source.title: China, The Maritime Customs. IV. Service Series: No. 1. Service List, Sixty-fifth Issue (corrected to 1st June 1939).
source.publisher: Shanghai: Statistical Department of the Inspectorate General of Customs, 1939.
source.provider: Internet Archive, item CustomsServiceList1939 (Public Domain Mark 1.0)
source.pages_transcribed: printed pages 1-5 (Inspector General; Revenue Department, In-door: Commissioners; Acting Commissioners; Deputy Commissioners in Charge; Assistants-in-Charge; Deputy Commissioners; Acting Deputy Commissioners)
source.ditto_convention: A vertical ditto mark in the source column means 'same as the entry above'. In this file the literal ditto is transcribed as U+3003 (〃). Dates are kept literal; the origin column is resolved and flagged with origin_ditto=true.
source.notes_on_uncertainty: Handwritten annotations and struck-through dates on some rows are recorded in the note field; when the print is unclear the note says so rather than guessing.
